messages:
maria.gomez: Heads-up — customer 'acme-inc' opened a support ticket: SSO started returning 403s right after they rotated IdP certs and uploaded new metadata to our customer portal. Error in our logs: 'Assertion recipient mismatch' and 'Audience not recognized'. They say they followed the usual metadata upload flow.

kevin.li: Oncall triage — any quick repros or is this likely metadata parsing?

samir.patel: I pulled the SAMLResponse they pasted in the ticket. Two things stand out: the <Recipient> in the assertion contains an explicit ":443" (https://acme.app.com:443/saml/acs) while our stored ACS is https://acme.app.com/saml/acs. Also their IdP metadata's X509Certificate block looks line-wrapped with spaces inserted at 76 chars. That can break our SignedXml verification if the importer doesn't re-concat correctly.

maria.gomez: Repro I tried locally: POSTing their base64 SAMLResponse to our ACS endpoint returns 403 with message 'Recipient mismatch'. If I edit the SAMLResponse to remove ":443" from the Recipient element it succeeds. Snippet from the assertion: 
```xml
<saml:SubjectConfirmationData Recipient="https://acme.app.com:443/saml/acs" NotOnOrAfter="2026-03-17T12:34:56Z"/>
```

samir.patel: Looks like two bugs aligning: 1) metadata importer keeps embedded line breaks/space wraps in the X509Certificate content instead of normalizing, so our cert parser fails to validate SignedAssertions when verifier expects a contiguous base64 string; 2) our ACS match logic ignores hostname normalization with explicit ports so a port-present Recipient causes a strict mismatch. Both could cause the observed failures post-rotation.

kevin.li: Workaround for customer now: ask them to re-generate the IdP metadata cert block as a single-line base64 (no whitespace) before uploading, or have them upload the raw PEM instead. Short-term we can also add an ACS alias that includes :443 in proxy rules to accept both.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-4287 created (sev: low-med) — link: https://infra.redwood/internal/INC-2026-4287

maria.gomez: Customer agreed to try re-uploading cleaned metadata. I'm provisioning an overlay acceptor to tolerate ported recipients for that tenant so they get unstuck. Plan: patch importer to strip whitespace/newlines inside <X509Certificate> and normalize Recipient host:port treatment. ETA ~2h for hotfix-on-proxy; importer patch in next minor release. Also flagged potential x-forwarded-proto issue: if their IdP signs Audience with https but proxy terminates TLS and we present http internally without x-forwarded-proto, some verification paths may also fail — asked infra to verify header passthrough.

samir.patel: I'll open the PR to normalize cert whitespace and add unit tests around SignedXml canonicalization. I'll also add a test that accepts recipients with optional default ports (443/80) when host matches.

kevin.li: Marking as P2 since customer can re-upload and we have the proxy overlay. Keep thread open until importer patch lands. Thanks all — :thumbsup:
